Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries applied CHAMPAGNE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright CHAMPAGNE sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied TURQUOISE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright TURQUOISE sheen filling every gap. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries applied RUBY RED metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright RUBY RED sheen filling every gap. Where two regions meet, the leaf colours interlock naturally: flakes of one reach into the other and the two colours simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
